# sscanf %d cases for tools/scanf-compat (C, the reference) and
# TestScannerMatchesC (Go). One case per line: a format, a tab, an input.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
#
# Formats (each ends with %n, so the output shows where scanning stopped):
#   d      "%d%n"
#   dd     "%d%d%n"      shows what a 512-character limit leaves behind
#   d,d    "%d,%d%n"     mapgen's Regions lines (mapgen.c:1764)
#   d,d c  "%d,%d %c%n"  mapgen's Land lines (mapgen.c:1940)
#
# Input escapes: \xHH is that byte, \\ a backslash, and {N:c} is the
# character c repeated N times (c may itself be \xHH), so {0:x} is an
# empty input. Trailing white space is always escaped.

# plain values and signs
d	0
d	42
d	+7
d	-3
d	-0
d	007
d	12abc
d	1 2

# white space before the number, none after a sign
d	 \x09\x0a\x0b\x0c\x0d5
d	  -111
d	- 5
d	+ 5
d	--5
d	+-5
d	-+5

# matching and input failures
d	{0:x}
d	\x20\x20\x20
d	+
d	-
d	+x
d	x
d	\x09

# hexadecimal is not %d
d	0x10

# overflow: saturate to the 64-bit range, then keep the low 32 bits
d	2147483647
d	2147483648
d	-2147483648
d	-2147483649
d	4294967295
d	4294967296
d	4294967297
d	-4294967297
d	9223372036854775807
d	9223372036854775808
d	-9223372036854775808
d	-9223372036854775809
d	99999999999999999999
d	-99999999999999999999
d	18446744073709551617

# the 512-character limit, sign and leading zeros included
dd	{511:0}5 3
dd	{512:0}5 3
dd	{600:0}5 3
dd	+{510:0}5 3
dd	+{511:0}5 3
dd	-{510:0}5 3
dd	-{511:0}5 3
dd	{512:1}
dd	{513:1}
dd	+{511:1}
dd	+{512:1}
dd	-{511:1}
dd	-{512:1}
dd	{1000:9}
dd	  {511:0}12
dd	{512:0}-1
dd	{512:0}+1
dd	{511:0}-1

# mapgen's Regions lines
d,d	1,2
d,d	 10 , 20
d,d	10, 20
d,d	-1,-2
d,d	3
d,d	3,
d,d	3,x
d,d	x,3
d,d	{0:x}
d,d	99999999999999999999,4294967297
d,d	{511:0}1,2
d,d	{512:0}1,2
d,d	1,{513:2}

# mapgen's Land lines
d,d c	1,2 a
d,d c	1,2a
d,d c	1,2	\x09\x0ab
d,d c	1,2
d,d c	1,2\x20
d,d c	1,
d,d c	-5,+6 #
d,d c	4294967296,-4294967297 x
d,d c	{512:7},1 z
